cause: The outer macOS Seatbelt path-denial profile prevented Codex from applying its nested read-only Seatbelt profile; macOS returned sandbox_apply: Operation not permitted before any reviewer shell command executed.
remediation: Use one outer Seatbelt profile that denies both disallowed reads and all run/repository writes, and disable the incompatible inner Codex sandbox. Preserve ignored user config/rules and ephemeral execution.
